title: The Lantern Trail
description: The lighthouse has gone dark. Follow the forest trail, solve five number puzzles and carry a little light back to the coast. An original technical sample; educational effectiveness has not been evaluated.

questions.prompt: At the forest gate, 7 fireflies join 5 waiting fireflies. How many lights guide your first steps?
questions.explanation: 7 + 5 = 12. Your first lantern glows. The gate opens onto a quiet trail.

questions.prompt: A bridge has 16 wooden planks. You cross 7 of them. How many planks are still ahead?
questions.explanation: 16 - 7 = 9. Your second lantern lights the rest of the bridge.

questions.prompt: In the orchard, there are 4 baskets with 3 golden apples in each. How many apples are there altogether?
questions.explanation: 4 groups of 3 make 12. Your third lantern shines between the apple trees.

questions.prompt: You share 24 smooth stones equally among 6 stepping places. How many stones go in each place?
questions.explanation: 24 divided by 6 is 4. Your fourth lantern shows a safe path over the river.

questions.prompt: The beacon gathers 8 sparks from each of 3 lanterns. Then 5 sparks drift away. How many sparks remain?
questions.explanation: 3 times 8 is 24, and 24 - 5 = 19. The last lantern glows. The lighthouse welcomes you home.
